editorial:
Imagine waking up in a concrete box with two of the scariest guys you have ever met. That is exactly where you find Alex, a guy who looks like he would not hurt a fly but is now stuck in jail for drug crimes. He is not just fighting for his life, though; he has a pregnant girlfriend waiting for him and a baby on the way. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure Alex is under as he tries to make enough money to survive and provide for his family. He ends up teaming up with a Kurdish boss and an old friend to run a crime ring from inside the walls, but things get messy fast.

You will love how the tension builds up as Alex slowly changes from a scared victim into someone much more dangerous. The acting is top-notch, especially the chemistry between the cellmates. While the middle part slows down a bit, the twists at the end make it all worth it. If you are into crime stories with high stakes, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final act, Alex realizes that the people he trusted were actually using him as a fall guy. He discovers that the Dutchman planned to betray him all along to keep the profits. Instead of letting them win, Alex uses the secrets he learned to turn the prison gangs against each other. He manages to secure the money for Julia, but he loses his innocence, ending the movie as a cold, calculating leader of the prison underworld.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about prisoners and crime bosses.
